common.apiUnreachable: The Plexus API is not responding
common.apiHint: Start the stack with make up, then seed it with make seed.

overview.title: Overview
overview.sub: What Plexus has ingested, what it has learned, and what it is allowed to do.
overview.pausedBody: The executor refuses every write while the pause flag is set, and records each refusal in the ledger.
overview.modelNote: Every model call is routed and costed per tenant. The local profile runs on this machine, so cost is zero and nothing leaves the laptop.

processes.title: Processes
processes.sub: Mined from the event log, not declared by anyone. Each carries its own trust score and tier.
processes.none: No processes discovered yet. Run make seed.
processes.eligible: Eligible for {tier}, awaiting an approver's confirmation.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.sub: Proposals waiting on a person, and the pipeline that produced them.
inbox.runBody: Plan, simulate, verify, then the gate. Change the tier and the same proposal gets a different answer.

scenario.task: Accepted quote, create the follow-up task
scenario.export: Share the client file with an external reviewer

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.sub: Append-only and hash-chained. Corrections are new rows; nothing is ever edited.
ledger.intactBody: Every row hashes to the value stored in the row after it.
ledger.brokenBody: A row no longer matches its stored hash. The ledger detects the edit but never repairs it.

boundary.title: PII boundary
boundary.sub: Every byte leaving an adapter is tokenised here before any model or store sees it.
boundary.source: Source text, as it arrives from the adapter
boundary.modelSees: What the model and the graph receive
boundary.inVault: Real value held in the vault
boundary.notInVault: Not yet stored in the vault
boundary.noLeak: No personal data remains in the tokenised text.
boundary.leakWarn: {n} values were not caught. That is a release blocker.
boundary.how1: Tokens are stable per tenant, so the same person yields the same token across Gmail, ClickUp and Drive, and the graph can resolve identity without holding a name.
boundary.how2: Swedish identity numbers are validated with a Luhn check and a date check, so a number that only looks like a personnummer is not treated as one.
boundary.how3: Real values are restored at exactly one moment: inside the executor, immediately before an adapter write, and never in a log.

graph.title: Graph
graph.sub: Entities and relationships extracted from the ingested sources, with their provenance.
graph.pick: Select a node to see what it connects to.
graph.provenanceNote: Every node carries the source references it was derived from.

adapters.title: Adapters
adapters.sub: Connected sources, what the executor has written, and how to undo it.
adapters.recordsNote: These rows were written through the action pipeline, which is the only write path in the system.
